description: Customer Interview Synthesis — AI synthesis of customer/user interview notes or transcripts (up to ~14k chars): themes with summaries and supporting quotes, pains ranked by severity, jobs-to-be-done statements, gains, current workarounds, surprises, opportunities with evidence and confidence, open questions. Every quote is checked offline against the notes and dropped if not found verbatim (quoteCheck counts; evidence strength per theme). Includes markdown. Param notes=, optional goal= (what you want to learn). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

notes.description: e.g. P1: I spend two hours every Monday copying numbers from Stripe into a spreadsheet. P2: The worst part is reconciling refunds, I never trust the totals. We tried Zapier but it broke constantly.

name: ai_interview_synthesis
